Sample Person Four
Business Analyst | Excel, SQL and Reporting for Retail Teams
Long Beach, California

About
Business analyst with two years of experience turning sales data into reporting that store managers actually use. I work mostly in Excel and SQL and I like the part of the job where a messy question becomes a clean dashboard.

At my current company I own the weekly sales reporting package and support pricing and inventory decisions for 40 stores. Before that I worked in retail myself, which helps me ask better questions about what the numbers mean on the floor.

I am looking to keep growing in analytics, with more forecasting and more stakeholder work. Outside of work I volunteer as a tax preparer during filing season.
